params.name: Top bar button
params.tooltip:
How the minimap's button in the top-left bar looks. Text:
the word "Map" without a frame. Icon: a map icon on a dark
tile, like the game's data layers button.

params.name: View direction arrow
params.tooltip:
Show an arrow in the minimap's camera box that points where
the camera is looking.

params.name: Show industry checkbox
params.tooltip:
Show the Ind checkbox under the minimap. Off: no industry
icons on the map, and no Filter checkbox.

params.name: Show filter checkbox
params.tooltip:
Show the Filter checkbox under the minimap. Off: no filter
window; a saved filter and Shift+click still work.

params.name: Show network checkbox
params.tooltip:
Show the Net checkbox under the minimap. Off: roads, tracks
and town buildings are never drawn.

params.name: Show high visibility checkbox
params.tooltip:
Show the Viz checkbox next to Net (while Net is ticked).
Off: no Viz checkbox; the network colors then come from
the "High-visibility network colors" setting.

params.name: Show stations checkbox
params.tooltip:
Show the Stn checkbox under the minimap. Off: stations are
never drawn.

params.name: High-visibility network colors
params.tooltip:
Off: normal network colors. On: bright, opaque colors
(yellow streets, magenta tracks, orange towns). Used as the
Viz checkbox's start in a save that never set Viz, and
always while the Viz checkbox is hidden.

params.name: Stations: train stations
params.tooltip:
Stn shows train stations on the minimap. Off: left out.
All three station kinds Off: no Stn checkbox.

params.name: Stations: airports
params.tooltip:
Stn shows airports and airfields on the minimap. Off: left
out. All three station kinds Off: no Stn checkbox.

params.name: Stations: harbors
params.tooltip:
Stn shows harbors on the minimap. Off: left out. All three
station kinds Off: no Stn checkbox.

params.name: Debug log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: Better Minimap writes every map build,
camera box and network layer step to the game's log file
(stdout.txt, lines starting with [Minimap]). Warnings and
your own clicks are always logged.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Better Minimap writes how
long its map builds, camera box updates and window renders
took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with
[SQPERF]). Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off
otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever
this setting.
